Usage: droide computer [options] [command]

Manage Remote Control registrations

Options:
  -h, --help                                            display help for command

Commands:
  register [options] [name]                             Register this machine for Remote Control
  remove [options]                                      Remove this machine from Remote Control
  list                                                  List computers registered for Remote Control
  ssh [options] <computer-name> [command...]            Open SSH connection to a Remote Control computer
  port-forward [options] <computer-name> <mappings...>  Forward local ports to a Remote Control computer
  help [command]                                        display help for command
